base.description:
{Mark of Fire}

The target takes double Fire spell damage for 2 rounds.

{Sleep}

The target falls asleep and cannot act, waking when attacked; it cannot retaliate against the attack that wakes it; lasts 2 rounds. No effect on undead, elementals and mechanical creatures.

{Wound}

Target Speed -40% for 2 rounds (in H5: Speed -40%, Initiative -20%).

{Cross Shot}

Shots hit the target hex and the ring of hexes around it.

{Shattering Strike}

Can attack walls and arrow towers during sieges.
